heroLede: Fresh cheeses like ricotta, bocconcini and burrata move fast and are finished by hand, so checking lids, labels and use-by codes takes your team's time. This is what a camera check could look like on a ricotta tub line like yours. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks that every tub has its lid, that it sits flat and that the seal has not lifted. A loose lid on a fresh cheese is a short-shelf-life problem waiting in a retailer's fridge.
labelLede: With ricotta, mascarpone and other fresh cheeses on similar tubs, a label from the last run is easy to miss by eye. The camera checks every tub carries the right label, straight and intact.
codeLede: Fresh cheese lives and dies by its use-by date. The system reads the printed code on every tub and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: With hand finishing comes gloves, cloths and small parts near the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there and stops it reaching a case.
